name: ISODATA Clustering User Interface
aliases: ISODATA Clustering User Interface — Cluster-space UI for TF Design, ISODATA-based TF Design
definition: A cluster-space user interface where ISODATA (Iterative Self-Organizing Data Analysis) clustering is used on a small subset of all data voxels to classify the volume, allowing users to design transfer functions by picking features from the gallery of preclassified features and refining them.
